title: Pro Shop Store Credit: membership entry and tier-movement terms by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Pro Shop Store Credit product line's membership-entry and tier-movement facet across every tier: whether an active club membership is required to open that tier, the minimum club membership tier-ladder rank required to open it, the bonus credit granted when upgrading into that tier, and whether the account may downgrade to a lower tier.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Active club membership required | Minimum membership tier-ladder rank required | Upgrade bonus credit | Downgrade to a lower tier allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Credit $50 Tier | Yes | 0 (any active membership suffices) | 0 USD | No |
| Standard Credit $100 Tier | Yes | 0 (any active membership suffices) | 5.00 USD | Yes |
| Value Credit $250 Tier | Yes | 0 (any active membership suffices) | 10.00 USD | Yes |
| VIP Credit $500 Tier | Yes | 5 | 20.00 USD | Yes |
| Auto-Reload Standard | Yes | 0 (any active membership suffices) | 5.00 USD | Yes |
| Auto-Reload Premium | Yes | 3 | 15.00 USD | Yes |

## Points of reference
- Every tier of this product requires an active club membership to open; the minimum membership tier-ladder rank required is the further condition that distinguishes tiers that any active membership may open (rank 0) from tiers that require a higher-ranked membership.
- The upgrade bonus credit is the bonus granted at the moment a member moves their account up into that tier; only the Starter Credit $50 Tier currently grants none.
- The downgrade allowance states only whether that tier's account may move down to a lower tier; the Starter Credit $50 Tier is the sole tier that does not allow a downgrade into it.

## Basis Q&A
**Which tiers require a membership tier-ladder rank above zero?** The VIP Credit $500 Tier (rank 5 or higher) and Auto-Reload Premium (rank 3 or higher).
**Which tier grants the largest upgrade bonus credit?** The VIP Credit $500 Tier, at 20.00 USD.
